svg.aria-label: Six forms of abuse described by behaviour rather than by incident. Physical: hitting, choking, restraining, denying medical care, and the versions that leave no mark such as blocking a doorway or breaking her things. Sexual: any act she has not freely agreed to, including within a marriage, and refusing or sabotaging contraception. Emotional: repeated humiliation in front of others, threats to take the children, and telling her she is imagining things until she doubts her own account. Economic: taking her earnings, controlling all the money, destroying stock or tools, and making her ask for money for pads or school fees. Digital: demanding her phone password, reading her messages, tracking where she is, and threatening to share intimate images. Coercive control: the pattern that ties the others together, a set of rules about who she may see, what she may wear and when she may leave. Each rule sounds small; together they are the whole thing.
svg.text: Six forms, described by behaviour
Most of what you will encounter is not bruises.
Physical
Hitting, choking, restraining, denying medical care.
Also the kind that leaves no mark: blocking a
doorway, driving dangerously, breaking her things
instead of hitting her.
Sexual
Any act she has not freely agreed to, including
inside a marriage. Refusing or sabotaging
contraception. Under 18 is defilement, whatever
anyone says she agreed to.
Emotional
Repeated humiliation, especially in front of others.
Threats to leave, to take the children, or to harm
himself if she goes. Telling her she is imagining
things until she doubts her own account.
Economic
Taking her earnings. Controlling all the money.
Debt in her name. Destroying stock or tools.
Making her ask for money for pads or school fees.
The form most often missed.
Digital
Demanding her password. Reading her messages.
Tracking where she is. Calling to check. Threatening
to share intimate images, or posting to shame her.
Coercive control
The pattern tying the others together: rules about
who she may see, what she may wear, when she
may leave, how long the shopping should take.
Each rule sounds small. Together they are the whole thing.
Treasured Vessels Girls’ Centre · treasuredvesselsuganda.org
